offering_description.value: Provides engineering, environmental consulting, and program management to government agencies, utilities, and commercial clients. Its technical teams assess sites, design water and infrastructure systems, and help clients deliver projects in energy, environmental restoration, and international development.

primary_services.value: water and infrastructure engineering; environmental assessment and remediation; energy consulting and design; digital and data analytics consulting; program management and international development assistance

customer_segment.value: B2G: Federal, state, provincial and local agencies, municipalities, and public utilities; B2B: Private utilities, energy developers, industrial companies, and property developers

end_markets.value: water and wastewater; environmental management; public infrastructure; energy and utilities; international development

revenue_model.value: project or contract: Clients pay for studies, engineering designs, and program delivery under fixed-price or cost-based contracts

value_chain_position.value: service provider: Uses field data and engineering expertise to deliver assessments, designs, and program management to public and commercial clients

geography_served.value: global: United States, Canada, United Kingdom, continental Europe, Australia, and project locations worldwide

specialization.value: related lines: Water engineering, environmental consulting, infrastructure design, energy advisory, and program management

distribution_channels.value: direct sales: Agency procurements, competitive bids, and direct contracts with utilities and commercial clients

regulatory_exposure.value: medium: Professional engineering licensing, environmental permitting, workplace safety, and government contracting rules
